reviews.text:
Not been genuine towards me.
Needed help with guinea pigs and twice used ready made excuses to not help me out.
Meant to be professional and to aim to help people who require paid professional services, but I have not received that.

I would definitely recommend using this place to board your rabbit I first left Ruby here in april whilst I went away and was so happy with the way russ treated her I left her with russ again in December, and will be booking her a place again in June. The service and care is first class .I can leave her knowing she'll be well cared for also russ gave me advice on feeding Ruby as she was overweight when I first left her but with the advice her foods been changed and she's kept at a normal weight since. Fantastic service.
Not a great experience unfortunately. My rabbit was sick on my return from working away.
